en.headline: Tuen Mun police arrest 22 in week-long youth crime crackdown
en.dek: Fourteen of those detained were students; offences ranged from drug trafficking and criminal damage to indecent assault, with six already charged.
body: Police in the Tuen Mun district arrested 22 people, including 14 students, during a seven-day operation targeting youth crime that ended on 20 August.

The arrested individuals, aged between 13 and 33, were involved in offences including trafficking in dangerous drugs, criminal damage, possession of offensive weapons, indecent assault, assault occasioning actual bodily harm, making off without payment, driving without a licence and drug possession. Eighteen of those arrested were aged 13 to 20.

Tuen Mun District Crime Squad Chief Inspector Shen Man-wai said four adults aged 21 to 33 were suspected of supplying drugs to young people and inducing them to commit offences for small rewards. Six of the 22 have been charged; the remaining 16 were released on bail and must report back in mid-to-late September.

Police said they would continue intelligence-led patrols at billiard halls, game centres, bars and parks and would work with schools to raise awareness of the risks of being drawn into crime for quick money.

zh.headline: 屯門警區反青少年罪惡行動拘22人 包括14名學生
zh.dek: 行動為期七日，涉販毒、刑事毀壞、非禮等多項罪名，其中六人已被落案起訴。
body: 屯門警區於本月14日至20日展開反青少年罪惡行動，合共拘捕22人，當中14人為學生，年齡介乎13至33歲。
被捕人分別涉嫌販運危險藥物、刑事毀壞、藏有攻擊性武器、非禮、襲擊致造成身體傷害、不付款而離去、無牌駕駛及藏毒等罪行。當中18人年齡介乎13至20歲。
屯門警區總督察（刑事）沈文偉表示，四名21至33歲成年人涉嫌向青少年提供毒品，並以「搵快錢」誘使他們犯案。六人已被落案起訴，其餘16人獲准保釋，須於9月中下旬向警方報到。
警方稱會繼續在桌球室、遊戲機中心、酒吧及公園等地加強巡邏，並透過學校聯絡計劃提高青少年守法意識。
